answer: Proof of Agent blunts Sybil attacks with an escalating stake bond: each new identity locks tokens, and the required amount rises with how many identities one backer already controls. A farmer seeding a grove of fake accounts pays a superlinear premium, so doubling identities more than doubles capital at risk. Honest agents raise one trellis per contribution and earn fees only after peers attest. A fraudulent ember gets slashed when collusion is found, burning its bond. The attacker's floor cost is forfeited stake plus lost yield, which outruns what a handful of fake votes could steal.
